summary: Render MIDI to audio with an instrument

arguments.title: ferraus render arguments
arguments.description: Render MIDI to audio with an instrument

inputs.description: Input file paths (MIDI files); globs allowed; '-' reads stdin

output.description: Output path or template ({name}, {stem}, {index}, {ext}); '-' for stdout

instrument.description: Instrument name or source: piano, strings, "String Ensemble 1", gm:48, sf2:<path>, sfz:<path>, builtin:organ, plugin:"Surge XT"; gm follows the file's programs Type: text.

map.description: Instruments per track or channel: "1=piano,2=strings,10=drums" (t2= forces a track, ch10= a channel; bare numbers are tracks in multitrack files, else channels) Type: list. Repeatable.

oneOf.description: Instruments per track or channel: "1=piano,2=strings,10=drums" (t2= forces a track, ch10= a channel; bare numbers are tracks in multitrack files, else channels) Type: list.

items.description: Instruments per track or channel: "1=piano,2=strings,10=drums" (t2= forces a track, ch10= a channel; bare numbers are tracks in multitrack files, else channels) Type: list.

swap.description: Substitute by General MIDI family: piano=strings plays every piano-family channel with strings Type: list. Repeatable.

oneOf.description: Substitute by General MIDI family: piano=strings plays every piano-family channel with strings Type: list.

items.description: Substitute by General MIDI family: piano=strings plays every piano-family channel with strings Type: list.

tail.description: Time rendered after the last MIDI event so releases ring out (2s) Type: time.

velocity_curve.description: Velocity response: soft makes quiet notes louder, hard needs more velocity to get loud Type: choice.

fx.description: Effect stage applied after rendering, like the fx command: "reverb:mix=0.2" (repeatable, in order) Type: text. Repeatable.

oneOf.description: Effect stage applied after rendering, like the fx command: "reverb:mix=0.2" (repeatable, in order) Type: text.

items.description: Effect stage applied after rendering, like the fx command: "reverb:mix=0.2" (repeatable, in order) Type: text.

params.description: Every parameter after defaults, presets, and run-time detection
